note: Synthetic print-through fixtures (2026-09-26, Brad's early-hedge idea). Shaped from the live-tree hours journals_v32/20260926T100000Z.jsonl.gz (a FAST sweep: 09:54:59.217-.271 the bucket YES side swept 0.57 -> 0.61 in ~50 ms while the wings jumped 12-20c in the same burst) and 20260926T200000Z.jsonl.gz (a SLOW sweep: one level per 0.6-1.4 s). Prices are normalised to the B79600 synthetic ladder used by the tests (n_top 0.50, rungs 0.50..0.40, offers 0.50..0.60), so the SEQUENCE (fast burst vs slow/stalled approach) is the golden, not the absolute prices. Not holdout/seal (those are 2026-08-*).

fast_sweep.comment: one ~50 ms burst that crosses the whole ladder; print-through pre-hedges the rungs the burst reaches, the rung fills land right behind it, the set completes early at the pre-jump ask.

slow_sweep.comment: the print climbs to within one tick of the top offer (0.49, offer 0.50) and STALLS -- no crossing print for > print_through_stall_ms; the pre-emptive hedge must resolve via the stall policy (unwind here, lock below floor).
